summary.text: Taylor Rickey is the Libertarian candidate for Oregon House of Representatives District 20 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democratic incumbent Paul Evans and Republican Andrew Fudge.

paragraphs.text: Taylor Rickey was born in Flint, Michigan.
He was the Libertarian candidate in the 2020 special general election for Oregon State Senate District 10, where he received 3.6 percent of the vote and Deb Patterson defeated incumbent Denyc Boles.
In 2022 he was the Libertarian candidate for House District 20, receiving 1.6 percent of the vote as incumbent Paul Evans defeated Republican Dan Farrington.
